offers_duration_complete.name: offers_duration_complete
offers_duration_complete.value: ("offers"."duration_value" is null) = ("offers"."duration_unit" is null) and ("offers"."duration_value" is null or "offers"."duration_value" > 0)

offers_net_salary.value: ("offers"."salary_net_min_cents" is null) = ("offers"."salary_net_unit" is null) and ("offers"."salary_net_max_cents" is null or ("offers"."salary_net_min_cents" is not null and "offers"."salary_net_max_cents" >= "offers"."salary_net_min_cents")) and ("offers"."salary_net_min_cents" is null or "offers"."salary_net_min_cents" > 0)

offers_gross_salary.name: offers_gross_salary

offers_collected_has_source.name: offers_collected_has_source
